title: Forming invariant stochastic differential systems with a given first integral
summary: This article proposes a method for forming invariant stochastic differential systems, namely dynamic systems with trajectories belonging to a given smooth manifold. The Itô or Stratonovich stochastic differential equations with the Wiener component describe dynamic systems, and the manifold is implicitly defined by a differentiable function. A convenient implementation of the algorithm for forming invariant stochastic differential systems within symbolic computation environments characterizes the proposed method.
